summary.en: Haiti's prime minister celebrated a police operation that killed gang chief Mathias Saintil, while a Haitian gang leader wrote to the United Nations seeking mediation and warned President Bukele that violence is rising after raising a white flag. Salvadoran forces of about 2,000 are searching for four soldiers missing after a gang ambush near Port-au-Prince, and they deny conducting airstrikes. The United Nations chief condemned a recent attack in Haiti that killed 47 people. The United Nations reported 193 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Haitis statsminister feiret en politioperasjon som drepte gjengsjefen Mathias Saintil, mens en haitisk gjengleder skrev til FN og ba om mekling og advarte president Bukele om at volden øker etter at et hvitt flagg ble heist. Salvadorske styrker på rundt 2 000 leter etter fire soldater som forsvant etter et gjengoverfall nær Port-au-Prince, og de benekter å ha gjennomført luftangrep. FNs generalsekretær fordømte et nylig angrep i Haiti som drepte 47 personer. FN rapporterte 193 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Haitian conflict
background.extract: Since 2020, Haiti's capital Port-au-Prince has been the site of an ongoing armed conflict between rival gangs and the state. The government of Haiti and national security forces have struggled to maintain their control of Port-au-Prince amid this conflict, with gangs speculated to control up to 90% of the city by 2023. In response to the escalating fighting, an armed vigilante movement, known as bwa kale, also emerged, with the purpose of fighting the gangs. On 2 October 2023, United Nations Security Council Resolution 2699 was approved, authorizing a Kenya-led "multinational security support mission" to Haiti. Until 2024, the war was between two major groups and their allies: the Revolutionary Forces of the G9 Family and Allies and the G-Pèp. However, in February 2024 the two rival groups united in a coalition known as Viv Ansanm, formed to oppose the government and the UN mission.
